techcrunch.title: Vogue just gave another nod of approval to the tech world
techcrunch.description: Vogue World is coming to San Francisco next year — perhaps another indication that tech bros are now part of the fashion zeitgeist.

techcrunch.title: Get up to $400 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until tomorrow
techcrunch.description: Starting today, you can take an additional $100 off your founder, investor, or attendee TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, which is a nice bonus on top of our current discounted pricing.

techcrunch.title: Google says hackers are calling financial firm employees to hack and extort victims
techcrunch.description: Groups of hackers are breaking into large U.S. financial firms to steal sensitive data and extort victims, Google’s security researchers report.

techcrunch.title: China-linked LightSpy spyware caught targeting victims in 13 countries, including the US
techcrunch.description: Researchers linked the latest malicious activity to a Chinese company, after one of the spyware's operators placed an order with KFC using their real name and office address.

techcrunch.title: Defense tech Hadrian raises $1.37B at $8B valuation
techcrunch.description: Hadrian is building automated factories to mass-produce parts for defense vehicles like submarines. It's backed by a long list of well-known investors.

techcrunch.title: Ford needs another Taurus, and the $30K Fathom EV pickup isn’t it
techcrunch.description: Ford's CEO has described the new Ford Fathom as a "Model T moment" for the company. But the EV pickup is unlikely to live up to lofty expectations, and maybe it doesn't have to.

techcrunch.title: Bumble teases a swipe-free future as it doubles down on IRL meetups
techcrunch.description: Bumble says it’s moving beyond swiping and deeper into real-world social experiences as it courts Gen Z users.

techcrunch.title: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
techcrunch.description: OpenAI said that ChatGPT free and Go users are also getting a new think button for complex queries.

techcrunch.title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company
techcrunch.description: Taking vibe-coding a step further, Naïve claims its infra can automate most of the work in setting up and running a business.

techcrunch.title: Hacker pleads guilty to stealing data from more than 165 Snowflake customers
techcrunch.description: Connor Moucka pled guilty to hacking and stealing data from more than 165 Snowflake customers, which net him and his accomplices more than $2.5 million in ransom payments.

techcrunch.title: TikTok lays off 250 employees, shutters its Nashville office
techcrunch.description: The social media giant is shuttering an office that housed some members of TikTok’s content-moderation team.

techcrunch.title: Google Wallet now lets parents set up secure balances for their kids
techcrunch.description: The tech giant says the new feature will allow parents to teach their kids healthy financial habits while maintaining oversight over their child's spending with built-in safeguards.

techcrunch.title: Gen Z dating apps like Ditto ditch swiping in favor of AI matchmaking
techcrunch.description: This generation of twentysomethings is so disillusioned with swipe-based dating apps that they'll try literally anything else — even an AI matchmaker.

techcrunch.title: Tesla and SpaceX will invest $16.8B to start building ‘Terafab’ chip factory in Texas
techcrunch.description: After months of speculation, the companies formally announced the massive project will happen just north of Houston.

techcrunch.title: OpenAI says Apple’s own security practices undermine its trade secrets case
techcrunch.description: Newly filed court exhibits show OpenAI’s legal strategy in Apple’s trade secrets lawsuit: argue that Apple’s own security and offboarding practices — including allowing an Apple manager to access a former engineer’s iCloud account after he left the company —undermine its claims that the allegedly stolen information was properly protected.

techcrunch.title: eBay continues to bet on live shopping after record quarter
techcrunch.description: eBay touted an increase in eBay Live's gross merchandise volume as it plans to expand it to more international markets in the coming weeks and months.

techcrunch.title: Amid legal battles, Suno says it will start watermarking songs
techcrunch.description: Suno's watermarking feature comes as the company is fighting legal battles on several fronts.

techcrunch.title: Ford’s new electric truck, ‘Fathom,’ starts at $28,350
techcrunch.description: Due in "fall 2027," Ford said Thursday that it won't reveal what Fathom looks like until early next year.
